purpose: Teach: 寄稿/半角/尺/収まる/見逃せ/絞る/手すり/低め

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察広報誌、寄稿、企業様にもお願いしております。
lines.en: We ask contributions to the police magazine from companies as well.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Clear enunciation on facts. Even pace, no urgency. The tone of someone who has explained this process before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害届の書式、半角入力指定、確認しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the incident report form — half-width character input requirement noted.
lines.style: Attentive, businesslike. Slight nod in the voice. Brief and direct. Shows he has read carefully and is ready for the next instruction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯動画、尺は、三分程度が最適です。
lines.en: Crime prevention footage works best at around three minutes.
lines.style: Informative and steady. Light emphasis on the time constraint. No inflection of opinion — this is established protocol being stated clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。犯罪統計、来年、収まる傾向、期待しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're expecting crime statistics to show improvement next year.
lines.style: Earnest, forward-looking. Slight warmth beneath the formal language. He means this — not performing compliance, but genuine hope.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 些細な兆候も、見逃せない、捜査の鉄則です。
lines.en: Even small details can't be overlooked — that's an investigative fundamental.
lines.style: Firm with quiet weight. Slight pause before the final clause, letting it land. The voice of someone sharing a principle that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者を絞る情報、社内、積極的に提供します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll actively share any information that could help narrow down suspects internally.
lines.style: Committed, straightforward. No hesitation. The assurance of someone ready to follow through on what he's saying.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 階段の手すり、警察署内も、改修しました。
lines.en: We've also renovated the stairway handrails here at the station.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement of completed work. Light ease in the delivery — a small accomplishment being shared without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来月の予算、低めに見積もって、対応します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll estimate next month's budget conservatively and manage accordingly.
lines.style: Practical, closing cadence. Acknowledging a constraint and committing to work within it. Brief, with the finality of someone wrapping up.
